title: hieracium sudeticum subsp. bohemicum
intro: Hieracium sudeticum subsp. bohemicum, commonly known as Bohemian hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestive health due to its anti-inflammatory and laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Bohemian hawkweed include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate pain, making it a traditional remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Bohemian hawkweed include flavonoids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
